note: Labels for a fast placement evaluator (tile transformer from arch-bakeoff-v1, with the opponents' style posterior as input). Every setup settlement decision of every seat (8 per game) in 500 games with per-game random style lineups; candidates = served top-12 + 4 random other legal vertices; 8 playouts each by the game's true lineup (CRN). About 1,000 playouts per game; about 4 h on ultra after placement-infer-screen-v1. Test split = last 50 games, never used for fitting or model selection. Fresh seeds 2896000-2896499. Its model will get its own predeclared offline gate (playout-rate ranking on the test split vs the served ranking and vs placement search) before any game screen.
